Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1991
ACT IV OF 1991
BANKS (NATIONALIZATION) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 6th April, 1991]
Whereas,it is expedient further
to amend the Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974 (XIX of 1,974), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Banks (Nationalization) (Second Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 5, Act XIX of 1974

ACT IV OF 1991
ACT IV OF 1991
BANKS (NATIONALIZATION) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 6th April, 1991]
Whereas,it is expedient further
to amend the Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974 (XIX of 1,974), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of section 5, Act XIX of 1974.--In the Banks
(Nationalization) Act, 1974 (XIX of 1974), in section 5, in subsection (6), for
the full-stop at the end the semi-colon and word "; and" shall be
substituted and thereafter the following clauses shall be added, namely:--
"(a) where
not less than twenty-six per cent of the shares in the capital of a bank are so
sold, the application of the provisions of this Act, other than this
subsection, to such bank shall stand suspended for such period, and on such
terms, as the Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette,
specify; and
(b) where not
less than fifty-one per cent of the shares are so sold, the provisions of this
Act shall cease to apply to such bank."
